verdicts.reason: A breaks the reading order: the SOLSTICE wordmark sits under the headline, and the headline is crammed against the green circle at the top. There is also a large dead gap between the body copy and the can, though the CTA is well sized. B keeps the original order (brand, can, headline, copy, CTA), but its spacing is uneven, with big voids around the headline. Its CTA is stretched almost full width, its label text is tiny, and it is jammed near the bottom edge on top of the yellow circle.
